title: That was wrong
summary: Kumo is on spot checks for sorting and trusted with your calendar. It bins a mail from Acme as a promotion and asks quietly whether that was right. You open Kumo's work and say it was wrong: the mail goes back to your inbox, the spot check has its answer, Kumo keeps what to do differently on How to help you, and sorting steps back to Learning, which Kumo's next line says. Then you ask to see every calendar change again.
